description: Source code for a client class interacting with OpenAI and Kilocode APIs, including functions for prompt handling and streaming responses.

classes.name: LLMClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with Kilocode's LLM API, supporting prompt sending and streaming completions.

methods.name: getKiloBaseUriFromToken
methods.description: Extracts base URI from Kilocode token, defaults to 'https://api.kilo.ai'.

methods.name: isFimMode
methods.description: Returns whether the client is in FIM mode.

methods.name: sendPrompt
methods.description: Sends a chat prompt to the OpenAI API and returns the response.

methods.name: sendFimCompletion
methods.description: Requests a FIM completion from the API, handling streaming response.
